name: AUDIOGRAM_METADATA
description: Contains values for metadata related to an Audiogram Exam. Including Technique, Transducer, Reliability, Baseline, and RSH ID.

columns.name: FINDING_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the finding record.

columns.name: AUD_BASELINE_C_NAME
columns.description: Item used to indicate what type of baseline an audiogram is. Options are: none, left, right, bilateral

columns.name: AUDIO_RELIABILITY_C_NAME
columns.description: Represents how reliable the Audiogram results are. The possible responses are Good, Fair, or Poor.
